purpose: Choose one value from a named set of radio options with keyboard navigation and native form participation.
behaviorProvider: Base UI RadioGroup and Radio with direction context.

component: Forward value/defaultValue, name/form, readOnly and change callback to Base UI RadioGroup. Render each option through a native-button Radio.Root with its stable value and disabled state.
Resolve group Field id, invalid/required/disabled state and description references. Give every radio its own label and optional description association.

Expose horizontal/vertical orientation and inherit or explicitly set ltr/rtl direction. With loop=false, prevent boundary arrow wrap in key capture after honoring a caller handler and preventDefault; otherwise retain primitive navigation.
host: Supply unique option values and meaningful group/option labels. Own controlled updates, domain validation and form submission; do not use the group to represent independent toggles.

Owned styling belongs to the input token group. Actual nested shared components retain their own group and behavior; preserve four theme/mode mappings and keyboard-visible focus.

limitations: Source-backed requirements, not a current test certification or release approval.
Public onValueChange is value-only; this wrapper does not declare the primitive cancellation/details API.
Orientation expresses layout and aria-orientation; the installed primitive owns the rest of keyboard behavior.
